'''Slime [[Yeast/Legends|yeast]]''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. It was an ingredient in the [[deepwater Dac pie]].<ref name="TOR:PfaD" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] kept slime yeast in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]<nowiki>'</nowiki>s galley.<ref name="SW52">[[Star Wars (1977) 52|''Star Wars'' (1977) 52]]</ref>
